scope: BASIC instrument and articulation decoding corroborated by initialized renderer snapshots; bounded width intervention fails timing isolation; independent native patch transfer rendered, awaiting listening.

render.sidModelOrigin: explicit experimental assumption, not recovered source metadata
render.observer: last-written register snapshots after renderer iterations; not individual SID bus writes, exact store times or a one-to-one video-frame trace

sourceInspection.lines1And15000: Clear all SID control registers at start/end, with master-volume clearing.
sourceInspection.lines12To14: Select AD, SR, pulse high, pulse low, waveform from instrument arrays.
sourceInspection.line37: Only two declared instruments; both pulse $41 and pulse width $F37.
sourceInspection.line99: Select instrument 1 on all three voices.
sourceInspection.line181: Select instrument 2 for voice 1; voices 2 and 3 keep instrument 1.
sourceInspection.lines57To62: Set frequency high byte before low byte; negative high-byte values request gate off then on; nonnegative values write gate-on only.
sourceInspection.line65: No continuously running sound program: interpreter waits for TI to reach 27*T after per-row timer reset.

patch1.roles: all voices initially; accompaniment remains here

patch2.role: main melody voice 1 from score line 181

basicInstrument.articulation: Negative frequency-high fields toggle GATE off/on; positive fields leave it high and retune without restarting the envelope. Zero-frequency score rests also leave GATE high. No TEST or ADSR hard restart is programmed.

intermediatePitchObservation.cause: Frequency-high POKE completes before frequency-low POKE. The interpreter separates them enough that intermediate pitches survive a renderer snapshot.
intermediatePitchObservation.limit: These are observer timestamps, not exact bus-write durations; audibility or contribution to preference has not been tested.

lead.vibrato: $14 delayed 16 PAL calls (~0.319 s), documented rate ~6.27 Hz
lead.filter: voice 1 low-pass, resonance 1, cutoff 832 down to 736
lead.hardRestartADSR: Configured $0F00; tempo1 bypasses hard restart (arrange-sidwizard.py native-first-frame-and-envelope contract). Adjacent notes without gate-off do not retrigger.

interpretation.verifiedContrast: The liked BASIC reference uses a fixed very narrow unfiltered pulse, faster attack code, lower sustain code and score-controlled legato/reattack. Ours uses a filtered saw, slower attack code, higher sustain code and added delayed vibrato.
interpretation.hypothesis: The narrow-pulse spectrum and selective articulation are plausible reasons for its more fitting foreground character; no causal comparison has yet isolated them.
comparisonLimits: Different score arrangements and timing; same-material timbral illustration is not a controlled lead-only A/B.
Different clocks and SID model choices; BASIC source model is unknown.
Nominal envelope rates describe full-scale cycles; clearing/reopening GATE does not guarantee a zero-level restart.
Snapshot timing cannot establish exact store times or isolated voice perception.
interpretation.recommendedNextBoundedTrial: Preserve our score and backing; independently transfer static unfiltered pulse patch2 before testing articulation separately. Native tempo1 gate/TEST behavior is retained, not BASIC interpreter timing.

listeningPassage.purpose: Starts immediately before main-theme lead pickup using patch2; arrangement differs from ours.
